items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: So, we told Earl he sure can play

ctx.x: So, we told Earl he sure can play, but somebody came and told Earl, well, he didn't read too well. But that's when he got Budd Johnson in to take Cecil's place instead of Lester Young. That was before Lester was with Basie. Lester was playing up at Minneapolis then.
Was Budd working -- where was Budd working?
